name: Dirty Flamenco
alt: Gary Meyers playing flamenco guitar beside a Spanish doorway, in black and white.
blurb: Brilliant, guitar-based flamenco musical act and one of the only in Colorado available for private events. Dirty flamenco plays real palos, and rhumba both authentically and with a soulful twist. Their polish as a working group is matched by their extensive standing repertoire.
seo_title: Dirty Flamenco: flamenco trio for private events in Denver
meta_description: Dirty Flamenco plays flamenco for weddings, corporate dinners and private events in Denver and the Colorado mountains. Book the trio on its own, or add a dancer for a featured performance during your event.
identity: Flamenco is just as much fun to watch as to hear, so this is a great act for a cultural event or a reception.
The trio's song list is built on the traditional forms of flamenco, and they play covers too.

ladder.build: Flamenco guitar, bass and cajón (a box drum)
ladder.bestFor: The trio is a great choice for cocktails and dinner. They can play anywhere from background to full volume, and they don't need a dance floor.
Bring in the dancer when you want a featured performance in your program.

setlist.note: Flamenco is organized by palo, the traditional form, rather than by song title. This is just a sample, and the trio picks from these forms to suit your guests.
